settings.title: AI usage
settings.description: Lets the AI Usage page, background jobs, agent notifications, the tmgr CLI and the TMGR runner read the session logs Claude Code and Codex write on this computer. AI usage never stores prompt or reply text. The runner reads the sessions it starts for titles, questions and status, saves detected questions with your prompt and the reply on this device, and may send reply text to Claude (Haiku) to spot questions. Turning reading off stops this; saved questions stay until you use Forget scanned data.
settings.scannedDescription: Usage numbers and runner questions TMGR keeps on this device.
settings.forgetDescription: This deletes the usage numbers TMGR keeps on this device and turns reading off. Questions the runner saved here, with your prompt and the reply, are deleted too. Uploads set up with {command} are turned off too; what was already uploaded is not deleted. Your AI tools' own logs are not touched. If the Claude Code status line hook is installed, it keeps saving limit snapshots here; they aren't read while reading is off.

consent.title: Read AI tool logs?
consent.intro: To show cost and limits, TMGR reads the session logs Claude Code and Codex write on this computer. Pick which ones:
consent.keptBody: token counts, cost, model names, timestamps, session ids, project folders and git branches, and the names of tools, skills and commands the AI used, file types it edited and pull requests it opened. What you or the AI wrote is never stored.
consent.uploads: Nothing leaves this device unless you set up uploads with {command}.
consent.scope: Your choice covers AI usage in this app, background jobs, agent notifications, the tmgr CLI and the TMGR runner on this device. With reading on, the runner reads the logs of sessions it starts for titles, questions and status, saves detected questions with your prompt and the reply on this device, and may send reply text to Claude (Haiku) to spot questions. Without Allow the runner reads none of it, even when you ask by hand (export, summary, fork): sessions show the plain agent name and no questions are detected, while running, waiting and exited keep working. Turning reading off stops the next read. Questions already saved stay until Forget scanned data, which deletes them too; if you allow reading again, questions from sessions whose logs are still there can be detected again.
consent.hasData: Numbers TMGR read earlier stay on this device. To delete them, use Forget scanned data in {link}.
consent.offTitle: Reading AI tool logs is off
consent.offBody: TMGR doesn't read your Claude Code or Codex logs for AI usage on this device. Change it here or in {link}.
